target: मेरे बच्चे रात को जल्दी सो जाते हैं।
english: My children go to sleep early at night.
reason: Sentimental greeting-card generality ("children fall asleep quickly in grandmother's lap") — a proverb-ish observation, not something anyone says. Replacement keeps the same habitual-present सो जाते हैं pattern about the speaker's own household.

target: हमारा छोटा बेटा कभी सब्ज़ी नहीं खाता।
english: Our younger son never eats vegetables.
reason: Preachy character-praise ("our honest son never tells lies to anyone") reads like a moral-values textbook. Replacement keeps possessive + adjective + कभी…नहीं habitual negation in an ordinary complaint a parent really makes.

target: आज हमने मिलकर पूरे घर की सफ़ाई की।
english: Today we cleaned the whole house together.
reason: Vacuous padded motto — "very good and meaningful work" says nothing concrete and sounds like a school assembly line. Replacement keeps आज हमने मिलकर + adjective with an actual activity.

target: अगले हफ़्ते मौसम और अच्छा होगा।
english: Next week the weather will be even better.
reason: Crop-yield optimism is niche rural content plus a motto-ish flavour; a learner will never say it. Replacement keeps the same future + और अच्छा comparative in the single most common small-talk topic.

target: फ़्रिज में ठंडा पानी रखा है।
english: There's cold water in the fridge.
reason: Decorative village-well imagery, textbook-reader register rather than speech. Replacement keeps the same location + ठंडा पानी + है existential frame in an everyday setting.

target: मैंने कल एक लंबी चिट्ठी लिखी।
english: I wrote a long letter yesterday.
reason: "The poet wrote a touching poem" is decorative literary trivia a learner will never produce. Replacement keeps the ने-perfective with लिखी and a concrete, usable object.

target: टीचर ने मेरी गलती ठीक कर दी।
reason: Newsroom-specific and Hinglish-heavy (एडिटर/आर्टिकल/सुधार किया) — niche register, not everyday speech. Replacement keeps the ने-perfective correction sense in a situation learners are actually in.

target: मैंने उसके सवाल का जवाब दिया।
reason: Riddle-answering is pointless classroom trivia. Replacement keeps the same ने + का जवाब दिया pattern with a situation that comes up constantly.

target: मैंने बच्चों के लिए खाना बनाया।
english: I made food for the children.
reason: "The carpenter made a beautiful wooden toy" is decorative occupation filler with an adjective added for flourish. Replacement keeps ने-perfective बनाया with ordinary vocabulary.

target: शीला बाज़ार से लौट रही है।
english: Sheela is returning from the market.
reason: Word-for-word duplicate of hi-0846 with only the name changed (शोभा → शीला) — padding. Replacement keeps the same present-continuous रही है pattern with different, equally common content.
